Nora-Sec: Heads up: discovery scan found several Vault transit entries referencing `wrap-key-internal-03` in partner-ingest backups. Noted unusual decrypt attempts at 03:10 UTC.
Ibrahim-Infra: Can you paste a redacted log line? need to confirm KMS resource path.
Nora-Sec: redacted: `kms:{cryptoKeyId: 'projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/wrap-key-internal-03', ciphertext: 'CiQ...REDACTED', aad: 'ingest:batch-7'}`
Tom-SRE: Immediate containment: revoke decrypt permission from non-admins, enable key-level logs, and snapshot affected objects. I'll run `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding` for suspected principals.
Rhea-Eng: We'll prepare a rewrap plan: create `wrap-key-ingest-04`, pause writes to partner-ingest, run rewrap in-memory, validate, then resume. I'll open a PR for `infra/scripts/kv-rewrap.sh` with safe flags.
Ibrahim-Infra: audit-bot, create incident and collect logs.
audit-bot: incident created INC-2026-5261234567. Evidence uploaded to gs://redwood-sec-incidents/5261234567/.
Nora-Sec: Also check partner IAM grants; if partner SA had decrypt role, escalate to partner SOC.
Tom-SRE: Found a grant to `serviceAccount:partner-ingest@external.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Removing it now and snapshotting.
Rhea-Eng: After rewrap we'll split keys (vault vs ingest) and add AAD validation in ingestion pipeline.
Nora-Sec: Thanks everyone — please post when rewrap done and include smoke test results.
Tom-SRE: Rewrap complete. 12 secrets migrated, smoke tests green. Rolling postmortem next day.
